artworks.title: The Little House by the Sea
artworks.description:
A charming seaside escape captured in delicate ink and vibrant watercolour washes.

Featuring a whimsical tall house with a terracotta roof, turquoise shutters, blooming flowers, and a peaceful coastal view, this artwork brings warmth, colour, and a touch of Mediterranean charm to any space.

Created on premium 350 GSM art paper, using an expressive ink-and-wash technique that combines loose, hand-drawn lines with beautiful watercolour textures.

Perfect for a cosy living room, reading corner, hallway, or as a thoughtful housewarming gift.

Details:

Style: Ink & Watercolour Wash

Paper: Premium 350 GSM

Theme: Coastal Architecture / Whimsical Seaside

Ideal for: Home Décor, Art Lovers & Gifting

A little piece of coastal happiness for your walls.

artworks.title: Santa’s Big Christmas Delivery
artworks.description:
Bring a little festive magic and a big Christmas smile into your home!

Santa’s Big Christmas Delivery is a playful, Christmas-inspired artwork featuring a cheerful Santa Claus pulling an oversized gift sack made from a natural pebble. Combining expressive ink-and-watercolour illustration with the beautiful texture of a real stone, this charming piece adds a unique handmade touch to the holiday season.

The vibrant red Santa suit, soft blue winter shadows, tiny Christmas present, and elegant “Merry Christmas” lettering create a delightful balance of colour, humour, and minimalist design.

Created on premium 350 GSM art paper, using a delicate ink-and-wash technique combined with natural pebble art.

Perfect for Christmas decorations, festive wall displays, or as a thoughtful handmade gift for family and friends.

Artwork Details: 
- Title: Santa’s Big Christmas Delivery
- Size: 16 × 20 cm
- Style: Ink & Watercolour Wash with Pebble Art
- Paper: Premium 350 GSM
- Theme: Christmas / Festive / Whimsical Art
- Technique: Mixed Media – Ink, Watercolour & Natural Pebble
- Orientation: Portrait
- Ideal For: Christmas Gifts, Seasonal Home Décor, Handmade Art Collectors

A little stone, a lot of Christmas magic! 🎄
